svg.title: A nurse is teaching a client who tested positive for an allergy to dust. Which statement shows that the client understands how to reduce exposure to this allergen?
svg.desc: A zip-on hypoallergenic mattress cover seals the bed off from dust, and it is machine-washed now and then. Vacuuming should be daily , not weekly. Carpet collects dust, so it comes out — the bedroom first — rather than going in. Curtains hold dust too: pull shades replace them and are easier to clean.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Allergic, Inflammatory &
Immunologic Disorders
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching a client who tested
positive for an allergy to dust. Which
statement shows that the client
understands how to reduce exposure to this
allergen?
What fits here
“I will put a mattress cover on my bed.”
Why it fits
A zip-on hypoallergenic mattress cover
seals the bed off from dust, and it is
machine-washed now and then. Vacuuming
should be daily , not weekly. Carpet
collects dust, so it comes out — the
bedroom first — rather than going in.
Curtains hold dust too: pull shades
replace them and are easier to clean.
